modification_description: The neighbor requires more enforceable and concrete mechanics added to the plan: (1) a physically separated containment zone for rain play, not just paw-cleaning; (2) an immediate cleanup/no-drift rule requiring paw rinsing before the dog approaches shared spaces; (3) scheduled rain-play times with advance communication to minimize runoff risk; (4) explicit cost responsibility and prompt compensation if mud/plant damage still occurs; and (5) a fail-safe escalation clause that triggers temporary indoor restriction or stricter confinement if mud continues to reach the neighbor's garden despite the setup.
